tui.tagline: Hears what you say, and hands it to any program that wants it.
tui.stats: Sessions {sessions}  |  Characters {chars}  |  Average {average} chars/min  |  Latest {latest} chars/min
tui.help.ui_language: The language of Anya's screens; System follows the system's language. Applies once saved.
tui.help.gain: Decibels added to every recording, dictation and continuous transcription alike; 0 leaves the sound as captured.
tui.help.dictation_enabled: Off unregisters the dictation hotkeys. Applies at once.
tui.help.dictation_device: A microphone records you and the room; a loopback device records what this computer plays (meetings, videos) once playback is routed to it.
tui.help.hotkeys: For example Alt+Super, F9 or Ctrl+Alt+Tab; separate several with commas, as in Fn, F13. Keys that type text (letters, digits, punctuation, Space) cannot be hotkeys. Press r to record one.
tui.help.mode: How a hotkey starts and ends dictation: Toggle starts on one press and stops on the next; Hold records while the keys are held.
tui.help.stop_delay: In Hold mode, how long recording goes on after the keys are released, so the last word is not cut off.
tui.help.output: Where Anya puts dictated text; None only transcribes and leaves the focused field and the clipboard alone. Programs subscribed to results are not affected.
tui.help.engine_dictation: Enter to choose the engine hotkey dictation uses; streaming engines show text while you speak.
tui.help.engine_continuous: Enter to choose the engine continuous transcription uses.
tui.help.engine_remote: Enter to choose the engine paired apps use for remote dictation.
tui.help.engine_settings: Enter to pick any engine and set its credentials and options; each engine keeps its own.
tui.help.language: The language you speak; Auto-detect leaves it to the engine.
tui.help.hotwords: Names, product names and terms to recognize better; separate them with commas.
tui.help.hotwords_file: A word list, one word per line, # starting a comment. Merged with the hotwords and read again at every session, so another program can keep it current.
tui.help.continuous_enabled: A background service for other programs: transcribes an outside source such as a meeting, cut into sentences at silences. It pastes nothing and leaves the overlay alone; results go to the log and to subscribers. Applies at once.
tui.help.continuous_device: The device to transcribe; blank records system sound from the default output, separate from the dictation microphone.
tui.help.continuous_hotkey: One press starts the service, the next stops it; this changes only the running state, not the config. Blank registers none. It cannot be a dictation hotkey. Press r to record one.
tui.help.silence_gate: Cut speech into sessions at silences and send nothing while it is quiet; off keeps one session connected all the time.
tui.help.address: While Anya runs it keeps a WebSocket open here and pushes continuous transcription results to other programs (dictation is never pushed). Loopback addresses only, 127.0.0.1:7590 by default; unix:<path> lets only you connect.
tui.help.lan_enabled: Lets paired apps on your local network (an iPhone, a browser, another computer) send their microphone audio to this Anya for recognition, over TLS. Off by default; apps need a pairing code from the settings window (Apps section) and can be limited or removed there.
tui.help.lan_port: The TCP port the LAN listener uses, 7591 by default. Applies when LAN sharing is on.
tui.help.overlay_enabled: Shows the recording state on screen.
tui.help.position: Where the overlay sits on screen; the notch is used on Macs that have one and is the top center elsewhere.
tui.help.idle_visible: Keeps the overlay on screen while nothing is recorded.
tui.help.show_text: Shows the recognized text in the overlay.
tui.help.debug_mode: Records key presses and the timing of each recognition in the activity log, for troubleshooting.
tui.device.loopbacks: Loopback devices (record what this computer plays)
tui.device.no_loopback: System sound is captured by Anya from the default output; no virtual audio device is needed.
tui.engine.settings_hint: (Enter to pick an engine to set up)
tui.picker.title_settings: Choose an engine to set up
tui.settings.title: Engine settings · {engine}
tui.status.stopping_detail: Still recording for the stop delay
tui.notice.config_reloaded: The config file changed and was applied
tui.notice.config_broken: The config file changed but cannot be read; the previous settings stay
tui.notice.delivery_failed: Could not deliver the text; it may still be on the clipboard
tui.notice.plugins_unavailable: Plugins are enabled but Bun is missing, so they are not running
tui.notice.overlay_unavailable: The recording overlay could not start
tui.help.update_check: Once a day Anya asks the Homebrew tap's host whether a newer version exists. The request carries only Anya's version number, nothing else. Off, Anya makes no such request.
tui.help.update_now: Enter checks for a newer version now, even when the daily check is off.
tui.update.state_unknown: Not checked yet (Enter to check now)
tui.update.state_current: Up to date (Enter to check again)
tui.update.state_failed: Could not check: {detail} (Enter to try again)
tui.update.available_homebrew: Anya {version} is available. Press u to upgrade.
tui.update.available_other: Anya {version} is available. Update it where you installed Anya from.
tui.update.restart: Upgraded to Anya {version}; restart Anya to use it.
tui.update.issue.not_homebrew: This Anya was not installed with Homebrew, so it cannot upgrade itself.
tui.update.issue.brew_missing: Homebrew was not found on this computer.
tui.update.issue.nothing_to_install: There is no newer version to install.
tui.hook.failure_unknown: failed for a reason this Anya does not know
tui.log.plugin_stalled: Plugin {plugin} stopped answering and was restarted
tui.log.hotkeys_failed: Saved, but the hotkeys could not be registered: {detail}
tui.log.unsaved_quit: There are unsaved changes: press q again to quit without them, or s to save
tui.error.gain: The gain must be a whole number of decibels
tui.error.lan_port: The port must be a number from 1 to 65535
tui.error.stop_delay: The stop delay must be a whole number of milliseconds, 0 or more
